notes:
Everything since 0.29, in one update.

**Markings that seemed to disappear.** An ink layer created for one piece could attach itself to another while two tablets were paired, filing later markings under a layer belonging to a different piece. Layers now stay with the piece they belong to. If markings ever seem missing, check the piece's ink layer first — they are almost certainly on another one. Deleting a layer now also deletes what was drawn on it, and tells you how much first.

**Erased markings could come back** on the second tablet, then vanish again on reopening. The second tablet was drawing an out-of-date copy over the page.

**The second tablet can now be updated from the first.** It no longer needs to join a network at all — which matters, because a second tablet joined to a workplace network can prevent the two tablets from connecting to each other.

**Transfers between tablets are more reliable**, including very large books, and no longer get stuck waiting for a message that never arrives.

**Pen haptic strength now matches between tablets.** The setting was applied correctly but the screen could show the previous value.

**More room for the music.** The page position moved into the tool sidebar, freeing the strip that used to sit across the bottom.

**Taps land where you put them.** Taps near the bottom edge were being taken by the tablet itself; tabs are larger, all the same width, and long-pressing one no longer closes it by accident.

**Importing is simpler** — one tap to the file picker, which reaches Drive and Dropbox. Obbligato also appears in other apps' Share menus now.

**A new recolour tool** changes the colour of anything you draw over, like the eraser but for colour.

**Jump to a hymn by number**, and various buttons and windows now match the rest of the app.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
